title: PR review structured output
description: First-pass review output; the renderer controls publication.

summary.description: Top-level review summary, posted even when findings is empty.

findings.description: Findings eligible for publication after review; may be empty.

severity.description: Correctness defect, unresolved question, or minor issue.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the primary anchor.

line.description: New-side line number, used to disambiguate anchor matches; 0 for file-level findings.

anchor.description: Exact changed RIGHT-side line, including indentation; empty for file-level findings.

claim.description: Defect, unknown, or minor issue in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Code references grounding the claim, with file:line citations.

suggestion.description: Optional exact replacement for the anchored line; omit for questions, file-level findings, or multiline fixes.

skeptic_rebuttal.description: The strongest argument that this finding is wrong or already handled.

suppressed.description: Rejected candidates and their reasons, including candidates dropped for budget.

why_dropped.description: Failed review gate or other reason for suppression.
